summary: Opened investigation @verify_quorum: VerifyLeader sizes its quorum over voters but counts acknowledgements from every replication peer, including non-voters, so it can report success without voter-majority contact. Added 12 source ranges (raft.go verifyLeader/quorumSize/checkLeaderLease/startStopReplication, replication.go notifyAll/updateLastAppended/heartbeat/installSnapshot, future.go verify vote, api.go, config.go), two sourced Behaviors (@verify_counts_nonvoter, @lease_voter_only) and a source-based conditional interpretation whose counterevidence is that checkLeaderLease counts voters only. Requested one focused execution of draft/assurance_generated_test.go: three partitions of a three-voter-plus-non-voter cluster (keep non-voter, keep one voter, keep nobody) observing VerifyLeader's returned endpoint, with the prediction recorded and no execution receipt cited yet; interpreting that receipt, and testing whether any legal condition lets a successor be elected while the old leader still reports verify success, remain unfinished.
